capabilities: Render interactive charts from tables or YAML in notes
Toggle between a Markdown table and its chart view
Update charts live when the underlying note data changes
Style charts to match the vault theme
Generate custom charts via an included AI agent skill
extras: Not yet in the Community Plugins directory; requires manual installation from GitHub releases, and the listing is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Visualizing data in Obsidian requires exporting to spreadsheet or chart software, separating evidence from visuals.
summary: Chart renderer that turns tables and YAML data in notes into interactive, theme-aware charts powered by TanStack Charts.
